scientific_integrity: All-size results proved by exact finite-population counting; 60 finite census profiles, 591 general sample pairs, and 2595 doubleton phase cases checked independently with rational arithmetic. No empirical population inference or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed known census, exact species labels, disjoint uniform sampling. The two-pair sign phase is not a classification for arbitrary sizes. Independent literature verification remains outstanding; a broader finite-population U-statistic treatment could subsume part of the formula.
title: Sharp covariance sign law for disjoint pairwise species-richness surveys
